so_what: nashsmom (2-2, weakest roster) lost Barkley for Week 5 and Rice possibly for weeks, so he is the likeliest first big FAAB spender and a buyer of any healthy RB or WR.
chrisroraback owns Charbonnet and Price but not Emanuel Wilson, the back actually playing; at 1-3 with Goedert and Keenan Allen out, he has the most direct reason to chase Wilson.
Nobody in this 14-team league has placed a bid yet, so the first real bid on Wilson sets the market, and his catches count a full point here.

brobertson2 (0-4) is the most motivated buyer: Kamara's full-PPR receiving role makes him a weekly starter during Etienne's IR stint, but Swift's fumble benching leaves the rest of his backfield a guess.
haleymegert lost Chase (protocol), McLaurin (hamstring) and Olave (knee hit) at once, which costs more in full PPR than in half PPR; he is a WR buyer this week.
Brian Robinson's three-TD night is worth less in full PPR, so hayhof (0-4) should not expect a trade partner to price him off it.
DrGMoney's Makai Lemon has real full-PPR volume (24% share) only while DeVonta Smith sits.
